title: Place the whole party in one go
summary: DMs can place the party on a map in a formation with one click, and act on several tokens at once.
items: Place party lists the party's characters: choose Cluster, Line or Circle, spacing and rotation, and ghosts follow your pointer square by square. One click places everyone, with Undo.
The formation can become the party's default.
Placement skips occupied squares, the edge of the grid and squares behind walls.

Select several tokens with Shift+drag, Shift-click or Ctrl/⌘+A (on phones, Select more tokens), then use the bar to place, move, hide, lock, size, add to initiative or send them to another map, each in one step.
The bar also sets the map's player movement.
